passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, it will be allotted to you as an inheritance with these boundaries: Your southern border will extend from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will run from the end of the Salt Sea, cross south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and go south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it will go on to Hazar-addar and proceed to Azmon, where it will turn from Azmon, join the Brook of Egypt, and end at the Sea.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to command the Israelites.
The LORD said, “You will enter the land of Canaan.
This land will be your inheritance.
The land of Canaan will have set boundaries.
Your southern border will start at the Wilderness of Zin.
This border will be along the edge of Edom.
Your southern border will also begin at the end of the Salt Sea on the east.
The border will go south of the Ascent of Akrabbim.
It will continue to Zin.
It will go south of Kadesh-barnea.
Then the border will go to Hazar-addar.
It will continue to Azmon.
From Azmon, the border will turn and join the Brook of Egypt.
The border will end at the Sea.
These are the boundaries for your inheritance in the land of Canaan.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ צַ֞ו אֶת־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ אַתֶּ֥ם בָּאִ֖ים אֶל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפֹּ֤ל לָכֶם֙ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן לִגְבֻלֹתֶֽיהָ׃ וְהָיָ֨ה לָכֶ֧ם פְּאַת־ נֶ֛גֶב מִמִּדְבַּר־ צִ֖ן עַל־ יְדֵ֣י אֱד֑וֹם וְהָיָ֤ה לָכֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֥ה יָם־ הַמֶּ֖לַח קֵֽדְמָה׃ וְנָסַ֣ב לָכֶם֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה וְהָיָה תּֽוֹצְאֹתָ֔יו מִנֶּ֖גֶב לְקָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְיָצָ֥א חֲצַר־ אַדָּ֖ר וְעָבַ֥ר עַצְמֹֽנָה׃ וְנָסַ֧ב הַגְּב֛וּל מֵעַצְמ֖וֹן נַ֣חְלָה מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּֽמָּה׃

passages.text: Your western border will be the coastline of the Great Sea; this will be your boundary on the west.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God described the land of Canaan.
God set the boundaries for the land.
The western border is the coastline.
The coastline is the Great Sea.
This coastline will be your western boundary.
passages.original: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם וְהָיָ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל זֶֽה־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל יָֽם׃

passages.text: Your northern border will run from the Great Sea directly to Mount Hor, and from Mount Hor to Lebo-hamath, then extend to Zedad, continue to Ziphron, and end at Hazar-enan. This will be your boundary on the north.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the Israelites.
God described the northern border of the land of Canaan.
The northern border will begin at the Great Sea.
The border will go directly to Mount Hor.
From Mount Hor, the border will go to Lebo-hamath.
The border will continue to Zedad.
The border will go on to Ziphron.
The border will end at Hazar-enan.
This will be the northern boundary of the land.
passages.original: וְזֶֽה־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֣וּל צָפ֑וֹן מִן־ הַיָּם֙ הַגָּדֹ֔ל תְּתָא֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם הֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃ מֵהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר תְּתָא֖וּ לְבֹ֣א חֲמָ֑ת וְהָי֛וּ תּוֹצְאֹ֥ת הַגְּבֻ֖ל צְדָֽדָה׃ וְיָצָ֤א הַגְּבֻל֙ זִפְרֹ֔נָה וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָ֑ן זֶֽה־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל צָפֽוֹן׃

passages.text: And your eastern border will run straight from Hazar-enan to Shepham, then go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Chinnereth.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites needed to know their land’s borders.
The eastern border began at Hazar-enan.
It ran straight to Shepham.
From Shepham, the border went down to Riblah.
Riblah was on the east side of Ain.
The border continued down along the slopes.
These slopes were east of the Sea of Chinnereth.
passages.original: וְהִתְאַוִּיתֶ֥ם לָכֶ֖ם לִגְב֣וּל קֵ֑דְמָה מֵחֲצַ֥ר עֵינָ֖ן שְׁפָֽמָה׃ וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּבֻ֧ל מִשְּׁפָ֛ם הָרִבְלָ֖ה מִקֶּ֣דֶם לָעָ֑יִן וְיָרַ֣ד הַגְּב֔וּל וּמָחָ֛ה עַל־ כֶּ֥תֶף יָם־ כִּנֶּ֖רֶת קֵֽדְמָה׃

passages.text: Then the border will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. This will be your land, defined by its borders on all sides.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
He described the borders of their land.
The border will go down along the Jordan River.
It will end at the Salt Sea.
This land will belong to the Israelites.
Its borders will surround it on all sides.
passages.original: וְיָרַ֤ד הַגְּבוּל֙ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔נָה וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֑לַח זֹאת֩ תִּהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם הָאָ֛רֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶ֖יהָ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: So Moses commanded the Israelites, “Apportion this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has commanded that it be given to the nine and a half tribes.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses gave a command to the Israelites.
He spoke to all the people of Israel.
He said, “This is the land you will receive.
You will divide this land by casting lots.
You will receive this land as your inheritance.
The LORD has commanded this.
The LORD said to give the land to nine tribes and half of another tribe.”
passages.original: וַיְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּתְנַחֲל֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ בְּגוֹרָ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לָתֵ֛ת לְתִשְׁעַ֥ת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֥י הַמַּטֶּֽה׃

passages.text: For the tribes of the Reubenites and Gadites, along with the half-tribe of Manasseh, have already received their inheritance.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Reuben has already received its inheritance.
The tribe of Gad has already received its inheritance.
The half-tribe of Manasseh has already received its inheritance.
These tribes received what was given to their families.
passages.original: כִּ֣י לָקְח֞וּ מַטֵּ֨ה בְנֵ֤י הָראוּבֵנִי֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם וּמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ הַגָּדִ֖י לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם וַחֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָֽם׃

passages.text: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, toward the sunrise.”
passages.sermon:
The tribes of Reuben and Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, are the two and a half tribes.
They have received their inheritance already.
Their land is across the Jordan River.
It is on the side of Jericho.
Their land lies to the east, toward the sunrise.
passages.original: שְׁנֵ֥י הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֣י הַמַּטֶּ֑ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם מֵעֵ֛בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָֽחָה׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “These are the names of the men who are to assign the land as an inheritance for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
The LORD said, “These are the names of the men who will assign the land to you as an inheritance.
Eleazar is the priest.
Joshua is the son of Nun.
Eleazar and Joshua will assign the land.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ יִנְחֲל֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־ נֽוּן׃

passages.text: Appoint one leader from each tribe to distribute the land.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave instructions about dividing the land of Canaan.
God told Moses to appoint leaders.
Appoint one leader from each tribe.
Each leader will help distribute the land.
passages.original: וְנָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֛ד נָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֖ד מִמַּטֶּ֑ה תִּקְח֖וּ לִנְחֹ֥ל אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah; Shemuel son of Ammihud from the tribe of Simeon; Elidad son of Chislon from the tribe of Benjamin; Bukki son of Jogli, a leader from the tribe of Dan; Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph; Kemuel son of Shiphtan, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim; Eli-zaphan son of Parnach, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun; Paltiel son of Azzan, a leader from the tribe of Issachar; Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher; and Pedahel son of Ammihud, a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.”
passages.sermon:
These are the names of the men.
God chose these men to assign the land to the Israelites.
Caleb son of Jephunneh is from the tribe of Judah.
Shemuel son of Ammihud is from the tribe of Simeon.
Elidad son of Chislon is from the tribe of Benjamin.
Bukki son of Jogli is a leader from the tribe of Dan.
Hanniel son of Ephod is a leader from the tribe of Manasseh, the son of Joseph.
Kemuel son of Shiphtan is a leader from the tribe of Ephraim.
Elizaphan son of Parnach is a leader from the tribe of Zebulun.
Paltiel son of Azzan is a leader from the tribe of Issachar.
Ahihud son of Shelomi is a leader from the tribe of Asher.
Pedahel son of Ammihud is a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.
passages.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָאֲנָשִׁ֑ים לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה כָּלֵ֖ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּֽה׃ וּלְמַטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ עַמִּיהֽוּד׃ לְמַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֱלִידָ֖ד בֶּן־ כִּסְלֽוֹן׃ וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ דָ֖ן נָשִׂ֑יא בֻּקִּ֖י בֶּן־ יָגְלִֽי׃ לִבְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה נָשִׂ֑יא חַנִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ אֵפֹֽד׃ וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם נָשִׂ֑יא קְמוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ שִׁפְטָֽן׃ וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ זְבוּלֻ֖ן נָשִׂ֑יא אֱלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן־ פַּרְנָֽךְ׃ וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ יִשָׂשכָ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא פַּלְטִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ עַזָּֽן׃ וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ אָשֵׁ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא אֲחִיה֖וּד בֶּן־ שְׁלֹמִֽי׃ וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ נַפְתָּלִ֖י נָשִׂ֑יא פְּדַהְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ עַמִּיהֽוּד׃

passages.text: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave a command.
He told certain people to divide the land.
These people would give the land to the Israelites.
The land was in Canaan.
passages.original: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה לְנַחֵ֥ל אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃פ
